facts.sentence: Corn basis on Nov 5 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 90¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 4:19 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Median of 17 elevators in Texas, 49 in North Dakota. 15 states with 15 or more. USDA's North Dakota average on Nov 4: 89 under Dec (USDA AMS, North Dakota Daily Grain Bids, Nov 4, 2026).
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.comparison: state median basis against ZCZ26, states with 15+ elevators
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)
